items.title: Medicare Advantage Insurers Are Redrawing the Map for 2027. Members Find Out by Letter This Fall.
items.summary: Millions of Medicare Advantage members will open a letter this fall that could quietly close doors they assume will always stay open. What insurers have already decided for 2027 and what enrollees do next could cost thousands of dollars or make coverage impossible to find.

items.title: UnitedHealth Stock Ran On A Repricing The Company Described In Advance
items.summary: The lever behind UnitedHealth stock's climb was a Medicare Advantage repricing management had described months before the run began, and the hard part was believing a plan whose author had just been wrong.

items.title: Wall Street Analysts Think UnitedHealth (UNH) Is a Good Investment: Is It?
items.summary: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for UnitedHealth (UNH) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?

items.title: UnitedHealth Group (UNH) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Q2 Analyst Target Increases
items.summary: UnitedHealth Group has seen its analyst fair value estimate move from $424.23 to $475.23, a shift of about 12% in the underlying price target framework. Recent research attributes this change to Q2 earnings, updates around Medicare Advantage and Optum Health, and refreshed 2026 earnings models. These are cited as key reasons many analysts are resetting their targets higher while still flagging risks around commercial trends, Medicaid, and ongoing regulatory scrutiny.
